title: Observe Record Contract v2
description: One record shape for every measurement and event, for writing and for reading. The record only grows by addition: readers ignore fields they do not know, and `v` changes only on a breaking change. Kinds, subject and ref kinds, attrs and measures are open strings checked against the merged registry (observe-names.json plus every observe-kinds declaration), never against an enum here.

v.description: Envelope version; changes only on a breaking change.

id.description: Deterministic for projected or re-imported records, so a re-run never counts twice.

kind.description: Dot-separated name declared in the registry.

ts.description: RFC 3339 instant. For a span, its start.

endTs.description: RFC 3339 instant; present makes the record a span, never before ts.

refs.description: Links to other subjects (plan, phase, backlog, session...); kinds are checked against the registry.

attrs.description: Dimensions to filter and group by. Names and types come from the registry.

measures.description: Numbers to aggregate. Names, units and valid aggregations come from the registry.

detail.description: Optional free text, capped in bytes by the writer. Empty by default.

rev.description: Version of the redaction rules applied to detail.
